{{Quotation|game|The Minister's Estate is the second-oldest example of classical [[Cantha]]n architecture still standing on [[Shing Jea Island]]. An ever-more-extravagant series of occupants has led to steady expansion; the current estate is three times the size of the original. It still serves the purpose for which it was constructed: it is the traditional residence for the Canthan Minister of Cultural Affairs assigned to the [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and surrounding area, a position currently held by [[Minister Cho]]. His menagerie of exotic animals from across the globe is considered to be one of the finest collections in the world.}}

[[Minister Cho's Estate (outpost)|Minister Cho's Estate]] is the traditional home of the Minister of Cultural Affairs, who is the highest-ranked [[Cantha]]n minister residing on [[Shing Jea Island]].

==Getting there==
* The [[primary quest]] [[A Formal Introduction]] grants access, but any Factions characters without a secondary profession or foreign characters (with or without a secondary) will be left behind in [[Sunqua Vale]].
* Foreign-born player characters can start at [[Shing Jea Monastery]], head northwest across Sunqua Vale, and head into the wall-enclosed compound. However, if the party includes any native-born player characters who do not already have access to the outpost, the gate will be closed.
* Access through [[Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area)]] is unavailable because the gate from [[Kinya Province]] to [[Ran Musu Gardens]] is closed if the party contains any characters that have not completed Minister Cho's Estate.

== Notes ==
* Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.1% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. This outpost and the previous areas contribute to 12.1% of the title.
* Foreign-born player characters cannot reach Minister Cho's Estate if there are any native-born characters in the party:
** If any of the native-characters are missing ''A Formal Introduction'', the entire party will be denied entry.
** If all of the native-characters have ''A Formal Introduction'', they will be granted access, but the foreign-born characters will be left behind.
